named_any_mention.means: the flow id appears anywhere in a spec file, including in a comment

bound_to_a_test_title.means: a test or describe title carries the id

ci_enforced_blocking.means: run by a required CI step that can fail the build

report_mode_only.means: run by CI in a step that cannot fail the build

distinct_recorded_passes.means: case ids observed passing in a recorded run; cases, not flows

frames_captured.means: screenshots on disk filed under a flow id

surfaces_judged.means: a verdict recorded against a frame by a human or a model

floorNote: named_any_mention counts a comment mention; the bound figure beside it is the honest one. distinct_recorded_passes counts cases and cannot be subtracted from the flow total.

inert_cases.means: test.skip with a title: never executes, and the waiver on FLOW-NOTES-002 leans on it

blockedNotUnbuilt.anonymous_fixture: no signed-out fixture exists, so the redirect journey is unwritable — harness, not product
